last_episode_to_air.name: Shooter (2)
last_episode_to_air.overview: DS Satchell is desperate to find his wife and daughter now that they are misssing. Walker and Connor try to find the evidence to put the Bilkin family behind bars. Satchell decides to take matters into his own hands when he feels he has nowhere else to turn.

name: Trial & Retribution
overview: Devised and written by Lynda La Plante as a follow-on from her successful television series Prime Suspect, this vast police procedural follows police detectives in England as they investigate crimes and the trials that come about as a result.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A five-year-old girl goes missing and the police are called to search for her. When her body is found, it becomes a murder investigation, headed by DS Michael Walker.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: DS Walker pursues Damon Morton, accused of brutally attacking women, but the case is complicated by false confessions and alibis.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: 15-year-old Cassie Black goes missing on her paper round in south London. An anonymous phone call leads the police to a boathouse in Putney where they discover her blood-stained jacket and trainers. An inquiry is launched.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: DI Pat North is assigned to look into a 15-year-old case that may clear a man convicted of murder eight years ago.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Walker investigates the discovery of a 17-year-old skeleton underneath the patio of a former bed and breakfast. His situation is worsened as he's partnered with North's ex-boyfriend.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Back on the murder squad, North is asked to investigate when a young mother of two is abducted. The confession of a local sex offender complicates matters, as Pat looks into the possibility that the father of a young protégé of the woman may be responsible for her disappearance.

tagline: From the creator of PRIME SUSPECT
